description: This file declares the EventThread class and EventThreadFactory class, which are part of the firebolt::rialto::common namespace. It defines an event handling thread with methods for creating, executing, and managing event functions, as well as a factory for creating event thread instances.

classes.name: EventThread
classes.description: Implements an event processing thread that executes queued functions asynchronously, with thread-safe mechanisms for adding functions and shutting down.

classes.name: EventThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of EventThread.

methods.name: createEventThread
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IEventThread with the specified thread name.

methods.name: EventThread
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event thread with an optional thread name.

methods.name: ~EventThread
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the event thread.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the event queue, ensuring all queued functions are executed.

methods.name: addImpl
methods.description: Adds a new function to the event queue for execution.

methods.name: threadExecutor
methods.description: Internal method running in a separate thread to execute queued functions.
